title: Investment Property Screening & Underwriting

blueprintSignals.name: Yield vs target
blueprintSignals.definition: going-in cap rate minus the fund's target cap rate
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Cap rates are computed on estimated income, so mark the income source

blueprintSignals.name: Rent gap
blueprintSignals.definition: passing rent minus market rent as a share of market rent
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Market rents are estimates, so use an interval

blueprintSignals.name: Capex need
blueprintSignals.definition: estimated capital spend per square metre from condition, age and survey notes
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Estimates are rough, so keep a contingency band

blueprintSignals.name: Debt service cover
blueprintSignals.definition: net operating income divided by annual debt service at current rates
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Rates change, so recompute when rates move

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Investment Property Screening & Underwriting": Screen listed investment properties against the fund's criteria and draft an underwriting summary with cash-flow assumptions. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Past deals are those the team chose to pursue, so the data is biased toward what they already liked.
